name: list_copy
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a.copy()
b[0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: list_slice
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a[:]
b[0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: dict_copy
code:
d = {"a": [1]}
e = d.copy()
e["a"].append(2)
print(d, e)

name: flat_copy
code:

b = a.copy()
b.append(3)
print(a, b)

name: alias_flat
code:

b.append(3)
print(a, b)

name: alias_nested
code:

b[0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: slice_flat
code:
